title: The Honest Tag
prompt:
**Scenario.** You found a pattern that fits all tested cases but cannot prove it. The contest clock says 2 hours left. Rank the options.

**Which approach is the best fit? The program only needs to print the letter.**

**A)** Trust it fully — the pattern is strong

**B)** Use it, but tag it unproven: harvest any partial bands with provable approaches first, keep the unproven path as the last submission

**C)** Prove it or refuse to use it

**D)** Ask a teammate

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: Honest tagging preserves optionality: proven partials bank points; the unproven pattern is used with its true (unknown) risk — and only when nothing provable remains.
